name: ai-agents-skills
description: Skills and optional hooks for Claude Code: Kanban boards, Git safety, review and verification, security, deployment, monitoring, research, Telegram notifications and reviewed skill import. Skills are named <area>-<object>-<goal>; only a small always-on set is described to the model and the rest are found through agent-skill-find. Depends on the superpowers plugin. Scheduled runs use a restricted Claude-specific prototype; automatic skill replacement and direct external imports are disabled.
